entries.composition: Landscape frame with the weir spanning the middle band, foliage cropping the bottom-left corner and right edge, and a cottage upper right; there is no calm zone for text — every area is detailed.

manta.take: Take the strokes that follow the water: a guide page for a waterfall could show falling water as upright slivers and the pool as sweeping curves, so a still picture feels like it moves. The crayon texture is worth trying in the background-art trials (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059); the turned-up colour would need calming behind listings, where your principles put the cards first.

mmm-infra.take: Loud crayon colour in every corner of the picture is the busyness Mark turned down on MacGeorge's site (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: Sitting in the shade, looking out at a glittering bay
entries.description: A bay seen from under trees on a beach: three leaning trunks split the picture and a fourth cuts across the bottom-right corner. A small figure in a blue cap sits against the middle trunk with their back to us, reading, while boats sit out on a teal sea with a scatter of soft white glints on the left. The whole picture has a fine speckled grain, and the far hills are softened by haze.
entries.note: Put the viewer in the scene rather than in front of it: frame the view from the shade, looking out at the bright part, so you feel you are sitting there rather than looking at a postcard. Let the light glow: soft sparkles of sun on the water, the only glowing thing in a soft, grainy, slightly hazy picture. The overall feel is a lazy, sun-warmed afternoon. Here the view looks out from among dark tree trunks at bright sand and sea; the person reading there is incidental.
vocabulary: shade-to-sun value step: dark foreground, bright middle ground
soft glowing sun glints with star flares

The grain, the haze and the glowing glints are worth trying in the background-art trials (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059).

mmm-infra.take: A lazy afternoon on a beach sells leisure, not the experience and judgement of an advisor to development banks (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: Two turtle hatchlings heading for the surf, in a few brush strokes
entries.description: Two sea-turtle hatchlings seen from behind, heading up the picture toward a few loose black brush strokes that stand for surf. Scattered ink dots read as wet sand, curved dashes behind them as their flipper tracks, and a small striped shape at top left is most likely a seashell. Black ink on off-white only; roughly nine-tenths of the picture is bare paper.
entries.note: A scene made of a few sparse marks rather than more detail: leave most of the picture empty and put each small mark exactly where the eye needs it, so the viewer fills in the rest, with just two colours, ink and paper. It feels light, alive and quick, and a first journey makes a warm subject. Here a handful of black brush strokes on bare white paper give surf, wet sand, tracks and two tiny hatchlings setting off for the sea.

entries.composition: Two hatchlings sit in the lower-left and centre third climbing toward a band of surf strokes across the top quarter, leaving the right edge and upper corners of cream ground open for text; no hard horizon, the surf strokes stand in for one.

manta.take: This is the brief you wrote for the footer (the strip at the bottom of each page): a few sparse marks, in just two colours, that turn a dark blue-green block into a scene. Flip it: white strokes on the dark blue-green background rather than black on white paper (brand sheet §3, its night pattern).

mmm-infra.take: The restraint: a few black ink strokes on bare off-white paper, with most of the page left empty, is how a hand-drawn aqueduct could sit on the white or legal-pad ground Mark floated and still feel personal rather than polished (brand sheet §2). Not the turtles or the beach: the subject here is the aqueduct and Mark's work.

entries.title: The mascot's own outline, filled with watercolour sea
entries.description: The mascot's exact outline (laid over the logo's shape, the two match almost perfectly) with no eyes or markings, filled with a watercolour wash: bright turquoise at the head, deepening to dark teal at the wingtips and tail, with soft cauliflower-shaped blooms (marks left where wet paint spreads) across the wings. A thin darker line, where the paint pooled, traces the edge. It lies on a flat warm sand background with one paler wavy band at the top left. Made in Adobe Firefly in two passes, each from a reference image.
entries.note: A watercolour finish where the paint bleeds and blooms into itself, gathers in soft blotches and pools into a thin dark rim at the edge gives a character a gentle, hand-made feel, and cool blues set on a warm sand ground glow. Here the mascot's outline is filled with watery blues, bright at the head and deep teal at the wingtips, on warm sand. The plain outline filled with sea colour is incidental: it came from testing fills for that shape.

The colours are already the brand's family (the tail is almost exactly lagoon-text), and the watercolour is worth trying (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059). Its sand is darker and more orange than the page sand (sand-page, §3).

mmm-infra.take: Another project's mascot in watercolour; this site's only mark is the aqueduct logo, which stays as it is (brand sheet §4).

entries.title: Botanical manta: a small underwater garden inside the outline
entries.description: A photographed watercolour on white paper: a manta banking across the page, its eye and a strip of cream underside showing along the lower edge, its long whip tail rising to the top right. Inside the outline, large wine-red seaweed leaves run along the body from head toward tail, fine rose-red fronds and small orange five-petal flowers fill the wings, and a plum wash flecked with white runs along the wing edges. Thin gaps of bare paper separate the pieces.
entries.note: Fill an outline with a whole little world, so the shape reads at a glance and then rewards a closer look, and keep the busy fill readable with thin gaps of bare background between the pieces, like the lead lines in stained glass. Pose it with life: tilted so a sliver of the pale underside shows. Here a manta holds an underwater garden: seaweed leaves along the body like a spine, fronds and tiny flowers in the wings, and a plum wash flecked with white along the wing edges like a real manta's spots. It was also kept to test whether its outline could be a rating icon; at rating size it cannot (see For Manta).
entries.source: Tracked in `docs/brand-assets/`, where it stays (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3170 decoupled the tracked path from the authorship claim). The founder confirmed on 6 Sep 2026 that he neither made nor commissioned it. No C2PA manifest and no recorded provenance (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3086 scanned all four PNGs); who made it is unknown and the founder does not need to know.
entries.licence: Rights unknown, and no longer assumed: lucmoseley/mantahostels#3086 rested ownership on "assume ownership where in doubt", which the founder's answer of 6 Sep 2026 removes. It must not ship on a live surface without authorship being established.
entries.image_recipe: A manta ray banking across white watercolour paper, seen from above at an angle so its eye and a strip of cream underside show along the leading edge, a long whip tail rising to the top-right corner; inside the silhouette, large wine-red seaweed leaves running along the body's midline from head toward tail, fine rose-red branching fronds, small orange five-petal blossoms and umbel flower clusters across the wings, a plum wash flecked with white salt-like speckles along the wing edges; thin gaps of bare paper separating every element; no drawn outline, no background, no text.
entries.composition: The creature banks across the left and centre with its whip tail rising to the top-right corner, leaving the right half below the tail and the lower-right corner of white paper empty for text.

manta.take: Keep the outline holding a small scene, recoloured for a page background or another large place where the mascot has room, in brand colours since wine and plum are nowhere in the brand sheet (§3). Not as the rating icon: drawn five in a row at the rating's 13, 15 and 17 pixels in lagoon on white, sand and ink, this tilted outline reads as a lopsided wedge — its tail vanishes and the tilt squashes the wings — while the current straight-on shape (§7) still reads as a manta; the rating's half-filled state was not drawn. Who made it is unknown, so the picture itself cannot ship.

mmm-infra.take: An ornate botanical fill inside another project's mascot has nothing for a site whose one mark is the aqueduct logo (brand sheet §4).

entries.title: Galaxy manta: a manta with a face, caught mid-swoop
entries.description: A painting by @artofbianca (her watermark runs across the middle) of a blue and violet manta swooping on a diagonal through bright clouds of yellow, green, violet and pink, dotted with white stars ringed by faint circles. The manta has cartoon eyes with white highlights, rounded head fins, a glowing pale rim around its whole outline, and a long thin tail sweeping in an arc to the lower left.
entries.note: Give a character personality through pose and a clear edge: catch it mid-movement rather than lying flat, give it eyes with a small highlight, let its trailing parts sweep behind it like a trail of movement, and ring the whole outline with a glowing rim so it stays clear against a busy background. Bright, joyful colour adds to the energy. Here a manta rolls on a diagonal mid-swoop through a rainbow sky full of stars.
entries.source: @artofbianca, watermarked 'Galaxy Manta ray' across the image itself.
entries.licence: No licence held, and the file carries the artist's visible watermark — private reference only, never published or reproduced.
entries.image_recipe: A blue and violet cartoon manta ray swooping on a diagonal, body rolling so both wing surfaces show in broad flat planes of blue and violet, two cartoon eyes with white catchlights at the base of rounded head fins, a glowing pale yellow-white rim light around the entire outline, a long thin luminous tail sweeping in an arc to the lower left, set in wet-blended painted cloud masses of yellow, green, violet and pink with small white four-point stars ringed by faint concentric circles, no text.
entries.composition: The creature occupies the upper-left half on a diagonal with its tail sweeping to the lower-left corner; the right and lower zones are dense coloured cloud with no calm area for text.

manta.take: Take the pose and the personality: the mascot already has eyes with highlights (brand sheet §6), and a turning, swooping version of it would suit the large places §6 names for personality, such as empty states, rewards and the 404 page. The rainbow colours sit outside the brand's palette (§3), so the verdict stays off-brand for the picture as a whole.

mmm-infra.take: A cartoon creature in a rainbow galaxy is playful fantasy art, the opposite of a calm, experienced advisor (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: Zentangle manta: blue patterns that flow along the wings
entries.description: A manta gliding down to the right, its whole body filled with doodled repeating patterns (zentangle): long strokes streaming out along the wings toward the tips, teardrop and paisley shapes on the body, dots on the head and chevrons below it. The lines are white gaps left in dark blue, in navy, cobalt and pale blue on white with a touch of aqua at the top wingtip, and a long thin tail curls up to the upper left. Saved as a screenshot on 19 Jul 2026; the artist is not recorded.
entries.note: Let decoration follow the animal: draw the pattern along the body — long strokes streaming out to the wingtips, smaller shapes gathered at the head — so the fill itself shows the shape and the movement. The hand-drawn, tattoo-like doodle style is worth keeping in its own right, for any subject. Here it is a manta in doodled blue patterns on white.
entries.source: Screenshot taken by the founder on 19 Jul 2026 (`Screenshot 2026-07-19 082018.png`); the artwork and its author are not recorded.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only. Never published, reproduced or shipped on a Manta surface.
entries.image_recipe: A manta ray gliding diagonally down to the right, head and curled head fins at the lower right, one wingtip at the top-right corner and the other at left-centre, a long thin tail curling up toward the top left; the body filled edge to edge with zentangle patterning drawn as white lines cut into dark blue: long strokes streaming along the wings to their tips, teardrop and paisley motifs on the body, dot fields on the head, chevrons beneath it; navy, cobalt and pale blue with a hint of aqua at the top wingtip, on plain white, no background, no text.
entries.composition: The creature spans the frame on a diagonal, one wingtip at the top-right corner and the other at left-centre, tail curling toward the top-left; the upper-left and lower-left corners of white stay open.

manta.take: Take the flowing pattern: decoration that streams along the mascot's body out to the wingtips, kept to one family of blues so a busy fill stays calm and close to the brand's own colours. The doodled, tattoo-like style itself is for other projects rather than Manta.

mmm-infra.take: A doodled, tattoo-like mascot belongs to another brand; this site's one mark is the aqueduct logo, which stays (brand sheet §4).

entries.title: Studio Wanderwell's jungle: calm hills stacked in shades of green
entries.description: The top of the 'Conscious experiences' page of studiowanderwell.com, a travel-planning studio: jungle hills made of flat, soft-edged shapes in several greens, blob-shaped trees, palms and red-orange flowers, under a pale blue sky, with the menu and name in white on top. The picture is a still image with no movement. On the live page the front green of the picture carries straight on as the background behind the page title and opening paragraph.
entries.note: A calm, lush scene with almost no detail: depth from stacked layers, each a slightly different shade, darkest in front and palest near the sky; trees as single rounded shapes with no leaves drawn; and a few shapes painted only a shade darker than what is behind them, as if half-lost in mist. One bright warm accent pulls the eye across, and the picture's lowest colour runs straight on into the page below, so the title sits on the scene's own ground. Here it is a green tropical hillside with palms and bright orange flowers.
entries.source: Screenshot from the founder's `brand_assets` folder, saved as `wanderwell1.jpg`; the site is inferred as studiowanderwell.com from the wordmark in the shot, not from a recorded URL.
entries.licence: No licence held — a private screenshot kept as a layout reference. Never published or reproduced on a Manta surface.
entries.image_recipe: A full-width hero illustration of layered jungle hills in a tonal range of greens, dark teal in front to pale sage near a pale blue sky, flat blob-shaped tree canopies each with a slightly lighter offset back layer and thin brown trunks, a few dark palm clusters, faint ghost fronds only a shade darker than the hill behind them, a cluster of two red-orange hibiscus at lower left and one small one at centre-right, the flat foreground green continuing below the art as the section ground, white serif wordmark and nav across the sky, no outlines, no texture.
entries.composition: The sky band holds the top quarter behind the nav; hills and trees fill the middle half; a flat green foreground runs across the bottom third as the ground for a centred page title crossing the lower edge.

manta.take: Build depth this way: a few bands of one colour family, darker in front and paler behind, each a soft shape with no lines inside. If the scene wants one warm spot like these flowers, make it peach, the colour kept for illustration; on the homepage, orange-red belongs to the search button alone (brand sheet §3).

mmm-infra.take: A whole top image in one muted colour family, with its front colour running on as the page's own ground, is one way to try the muted background Mark floated, and lets the opening animation's last frame become the homepage rather than cut to it (brand sheet §2). Not the jungle, palms or orange flowers: the scene should be the aqueduct, and Mark has chosen no colour yet (§2 is open).

entries.title: Studio Wanderwell's snow scene: a slope that becomes the white page
entries.description: The top of the 'Our story' page of studiowanderwell.com as it looked when he saved it in July 2026. Pale blue flat mountains, a white snowfield sweeping up from the left to the right edge, a row of small dark-green fir trees shrinking along the left, and the menu and name in white across the sky. The snow is the same pure white as the page below, so the picture has no bottom edge; two thin grey ski tracks are the only marks on it. The live 'Our story' page now opens on a safari scene instead, so this one can only be checked in his screenshot.
entries.note: Crisp, quiet and airy: a whole scene kept to one family of pale colours with a single darker accent, and soft, rounded mountain shapes. It ends by running its lightest area into the page's own colour with no edge, with one small clue telling you what that empty area still is. Here a snowy slope curves down into the white page, and two faint ski tracks are all that say the white is still snow; the soft peaks could as easily be volcanoes.
entries.source: Screenshot from the founder's `brand_assets` folder, saved as `wanderwell3.jpg`; the site is inferred as studiowanderwell.com from the wordmark in the shot, not from a recorded URL. On 29 Sep 2026 the live 'Our story' page showed a different scene, a pink safari with giraffes, so the snow scene survives only in this screenshot.
entries.licence: No licence held — a private screenshot kept as a layout reference. Never published or reproduced on a Manta surface.
entries.image_recipe: A wide hero illustration of pale periwinkle mountain silhouettes with soft curved peaks in four or five tones of one blue, a white snowfield rising in one long curve from lower left to the right edge, a row of small rounded dark-green conifers with one lighter highlight stripe each, shrinking in size along the left edge, one thin white track line on the far slope and a pair of thin grey ski tracks curving across the white, the white snow identical to the page white below so the art has no bottom edge, white serif wordmark and nav across the sky, no outlines, no texture.
entries.composition: Mountains fill the top two-thirds behind a centred nav, a white snowfield rises from lower left to the right edge and merges with the page, and conifers stay small at the left edge, leaving the lower third white for content.

manta.take: A device for the big top images of destination pages and for artwork inside sections, not the homepage: Manta's homepage top image ends in a dark blue-green band over the pale sand page colour (brand sheet §8), a visible join on purpose.

mmm-infra.take: A scene in pale blues whose nearest area is the same white as the page, with no edge, is a ready answer to Mark's 'dissolve to the homepage' on a white ground: the aqueduct's foreground could simply become the page (brand sheet §6). Not the mountains, firs or ski tracks; and the pale blues would need checking against the logo blue (§2).

entries.title: Studio Wanderwell's beach at sunset, words on plain sky
entries.description: The top of the home page of studiowanderwell.com, still live on 29 Sep 2026. A coral-pink sky over a blue bay, a pale half-set sun, brown headlands on the left mirrored as a darker patch on the water, a yellow beach with one striped umbrella, and a dark green palm leaf reaching in from the bottom-right corner. The headline 'Creators of incredible time off' is real text on the plain sky just above the horizon, with an outlined 'GET STARTED' button on the plain sea below. The picture is a still image; its lowest band is the same sand colour as the page beneath, so the beach carries on under the text that follows.
entries.note: Warm, easy and unhurried, the end of a day out, drawn in a handful of flat colours. The picture makes room for words: the headline sits on empty sky and the button on empty water, while the scenery crowds the edges, and one leaf in the near corner puts you on the beach, looking out. Here it is a beach at the end of the day, framed by headlands and a palm leaf.
entries.source: Screenshot from the founder's `brand_assets` folder, saved as `wanderwell4.jpg`; the site is inferred as studiowanderwell.com from the wordmark in the shot, not from a recorded URL.
entries.licence: No licence held — a private screenshot kept as a layout reference. Never published or reproduced on a Manta surface.
entries.image_recipe: A wide hero illustration: flat coral-pink sky, a pale half-set sun disc on a crisp horizon, three brown and rust headlands at the left with a darker blue reflection shape on the water below them, a flat blue bay with lighter blue bands of shallow water curving onto a yellow sand spit, one tiny navy-and-white striped parasol with a flat shadow, one dark green palm frond cropped into the lower-right corner, a pale cream shore band and the page's sand colour as the lowest band, a centred white geometric sans headline on the plain sky and a thin double-ruled ghost button on the plain sea, no outlines, no texture.
entries.composition: Horizon sits just above centre with the headline on plain sky directly above it and the ghost button on plain sea below; headlands occupy the left edge, beach and a cropped palm frond the lower right.

manta.take: The closest thing in the folder to brand sheet §8 as written: flat shapes, a crisp horizon, a small set of flat colours, and a headline easy to read on a plain background rather than over detail. Take the layout as a whole; the colours are theirs.

mmm-infra.take: The layout that makes room for words: one line on empty sky and one quiet outlined button on empty water, with the picture kept to the edges, is how the homepage could ask its one thing, to get in touch with Mark, after a calm opening (brand sheet §1). Not the coral sunset and beach, which sell a holiday, and not a slogan like 'Creators of…', which speaks as a firm, not as Mark (§5).

entries.title: Tiny hooded figure meets a giant squirrel in golden light
entries.description: A digital painting: a huge red squirrel on the right lowers its nose toward a tiny figure in a pale hooded suit, who holds a dark, pine-cone-like object up to it. Behind them are an orange autumn field, grey-blue cliffs and a bare tree at the left edge, all in broad, flat, angular strokes like paint spread with a knife. Almost everything is warm ochre, orange and rust. The saved file is small (728 × 420 pixels), and its artist is not recorded.
entries.note: Warm golden light over a whole scene, late-afternoon and storybook-like, painted in rough, knife-like strokes whose texture carries as much of the feel as the colour. Here it is a golden scene with a giant squirrel; the small person meeting it is incidental, and scenes without people are preferred.
entries.source: Founder's `brand_assets` folder; the original artist and the page it was saved from are not recorded (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3042 sorted the folder without provenance).
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only. Never published, reproduced or shipped on a Manta surface.
entries.image_recipe: A huge red squirrel on the right of the frame lowering its nose toward a tiny figure in a pale hooded suit at lower centre-left, who holds a dark pine cone up to it, an orange autumn field, grey-blue cliffs behind, a bare dark-red tree cutting in at the left edge, broad flat angular palette-knife strokes, warm ochre, orange and rust palette with cool grey-blue only in the backdrop, golden late-afternoon light, no outlines, no text.
entries.composition: The creature fills the right half, the small figure stands at lower centre-left, and a tree frames the left edge; the upper-left sky area is the only relatively calm zone for text.

manta.take: Take the warm golden storybook light and the rough, knife-like painted texture, both worth trying in the background-art trials (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059). Leave the person out: you prefer scenes without people.

mmm-infra.take: A storybook fantasy scene with a giant squirrel has nothing for a calm, personal advisor's site for development-bank staff (brand sheet §1).

entries.title: Girl in a breeze, flat shapes with a fine speckle
entries.description: A girl with short purple hair and closed eyes holds a bunch of orange-red tulips. One white rabbit sits on her shoulder holding a single tulip, and another peeks out of the bouquet. Her hair and a red ribbon stream to the right as if in a breeze. Everything is built from soft flat shapes with no outlines, each filled with a fine grain, with tiny coloured flecks scattered over a pale blush-pink background.
entries.note: Soft, happy and light, a moment of contentment caught mid-breeze, finished with flat shapes filled with a fine speckled grain and tiny flecks scattered over everything, adding warmth without adding detail. Here a figure with eyes closed, hair and ribbon blowing one way and little flecks drifting off, sits with two rabbits; the stag picture saved two minutes earlier, one of the top background examples, has a similar finish.
entries.source: Dribbble, saved as `dribbble4.jpg` into the founder's `brand_assets` folder; the shot and its author are not recorded (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3042 sorted the folder without provenance).
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only. Never published, reproduced or shipped on a Manta surface.
entries.image_recipe: A girl with short purple bobbed hair and closed eyes in a soft pink coat with a puffed sleeve, holding a bunch of orange-red tulips with long green leaves, one small white rabbit sitting on her shoulder holding a single tulip and another peeking out of the bouquet, hair and a red ribbon streaming to the right in a breeze, flat shapes with no outlines filled with fine speckled grain, scattered white and rust flecks drifting across a pale blush background, no text.
entries.composition: The figure stands right of centre and is cropped at the bottom edge, the bouquet fans to the upper left, leaving the left strip and top edge of blush ground open.

manta.take: What could carry over is the finish: flat shapes with a fine speckle inside them and a few flecks drifting over, worth trying in the background-art trials (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059). The pastel colours and the person at the centre stay theirs.

mmm-infra.take: A whimsical pastel figure with rabbits and tulips is gentle children's-book art, not the voice of an experienced infrastructure advisor (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: Three-ink moth: a mirrored winged creature packed with pattern
entries.description: A moth seen from directly above on cream paper, its two halves mirror images, printed in three inks: red, blue and a dark plum. Blue shapes carry a fine white dot pattern, red areas fade out in a sprayed speckle, and where blue lies over red it turns purple. Thin dark veins with round dot tips fan out across the lower wings, and the body carries zigzag patterns.
entries.note: Bold, crafted and a little retro, like a hand-printed poster: a few inks overlap, each with its own texture of dots or spray, and the overlaps make new colours. A winged creature seen from above, wings spread and filled edge to edge with pattern, suits it. Here it is a moth printed in three inks.
entries.source: Dribbble, saved as `dribbble5.jpg` into the founder's `brand_assets` folder; the shot and its author are not recorded (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3042 sorted the folder without provenance).
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only. Never published, reproduced or shipped on a Manta surface.
entries.image_recipe: A symmetrical moth seen from above on a cream ground, wings blocked in red, blue and near-black flat shapes with dotted halftone overlays where colours cross, thin dark veins ending in small round tips radiating from a patterned body, risograph print texture with slight misregistration, no outlines, no text.
entries.composition: A centred symmetrical subject fills almost the whole frame, wingtips near both edges, leaving only thin cream margins and the V between the upper wings open.

manta.take: Not for Manta: in your words, 'I don't think this should be used for mantahostels at all.' Kept for other projects.

mmm-infra.take: A loud three-ink moth packed with pattern is decorative poster art with nothing for a calm site built around an aqueduct (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: Painted portrait in dappled sunlight under leaves
entries.description: A digital painting of a young woman with braided rose-red hair and a pointed, elf-like ear with a gold leaf-shaped cuff, holding a leafy sprig of small oval leaves close to her face. The background is almost white with light, and leaves hang in from the top left and crowd the right edge. Soft round patches of sunlight fall across her arm. The artist is not recorded; his own file name for it was 'painterly_fantasy'.
entries.note: A sample of a painting style: bright, warm and dreamy, smooth painted forms in glowing light. Within it, sunlight falling through leaves in soft round patches, leaves in the sun turning warm yellow-green and those in shade cool blue-green, with leaves framing the edges. Here it is a painted portrait under leaves; the portrait itself is incidental.
entries.source: Founder's `brand_assets` folder; the original artist and the page it was saved from are not recorded (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3042 sorted the folder without provenance).

The idea inside it is sunlight through leaves: paler, soft-edged patches on the ground under a tree, warm where lit and cool in shade.

mmm-infra.take: A fantasy portrait with an elf's ear has nothing for a personal advisor's site; the person this site shows is Mark, in real photographs (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: Painted portrait, eyes closed, fading into grey-blue strokes
entries.description: A small (399 × 501 pixel) digital painting of a young woman with her eyes closed, freckles across her cheeks and nose, and a coral mouth. The face is carefully finished, while her brown hair and the grey-blue background around it are left as loose, visible brush strokes that blur into each other. The artist is not recorded; his own file name for it was 'painterly_normal'.
entries.note: A sample of a loose painting style: calm, quiet brushwork that finishes the one focal point with care and lets everything around it melt into a few relaxed strokes, as if seen through a haze. Here the face is the finished part and the rest dissolves into grey-blue brushwork; its file name, 'painterly_normal', marks it as one of three painting-style samples.
entries.source: Founder's `brand_assets` folder; the original artist and the page it was saved from are not recorded (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3042 sorted the folder without provenance).
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only. Never published, reproduced or shipped on a Manta surface.

manta.take: Not the portrait: the loose painting style is one to try (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059), and so is where it spends its detail — finished at the one point the eye should land (on Manta, the mascot or a landmark) while the surroundings soften into a few loose shapes.

mmm-infra.take: A painted portrait of a stranger is a style sample with no use here: the face on this site is Mark's own, from his photographs (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: Painted portrait split in hot magenta and cool blue
entries.description: A digital painting of a young woman looking straight out, hand under her chin, her face lit from two sides: one half hot magenta, the other pale cool blue. Her dark hair is painted in fast wet strokes with scribbled lines, drips, spatter and a streak of gold across the top, over a violet-to-pink brushed background. A small boxed monogram signature sits at lower right; the artist is not otherwise recorded, and his own file name for it was 'painterly_purple'.
entries.note: Loud, energetic colour, lit so the subject splits cleanly into one warm side and one cool side, with fast, scribbly brushwork, drips and streaks keeping everything lively. Here a violet-and-pink portrait divides down the nose into hot pink and cool blue, with a gold streak around it.
entries.source: Founder's `brand_assets` folder; the original artist and the page it was saved from are not recorded (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3042 sorted the folder without provenance).
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only. Never published, reproduced or shipped on a Manta surface.
entries.image_recipe: A three-quarter portrait of a woman lit from two sides, one half of the face in hot magenta and the other in cold blue-white, dark hair painted in loose wet strokes with gold flecks through it, a violet-to-pink brushed background, visible brush marks throughout, no text.
entries.composition: The face fills the centre from top to bottom with hair spreading to both upper corners; only thin violet margins at the far left and right are open.

manta.take: Not the portrait: the warm-and-cool split is the idea that carries, lighting a subject with one warm side and one cool side. The loud, scribbled painting is a style to try for the loud places, such as the home page's opening or rewards, rather than behind listings, where your principles put the cards first (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059).

mmm-infra.take: A loud magenta-and-blue portrait with drips and scribbles is the opposite of calm, and the face on this site is Mark's own, from his photographs (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: ATELO - Interior Gallery
entries.description: A warm cream page with a row of five interior photos across the top: a living room, a kitchen, a wall of shelving, a dining area with kitchen, and a bedroom. The middle photo is larger and in full colour; the two on each side are washed out and pale. Below, a short paragraph and a "VIEW CASE STUDY" link sit on the right with lots of empty space around them, above a small "Melbourne, AU | Est. 2015" line and a huge two-line headline, "DESIGNED TO / STAND APART", in a bold plain modern font, dark brown with "STAND" in tan.
entries.note: Use a strip of images as a preview of the work, then let a giant headline, its two lines offset, hold down the bottom half of the page. The middle image stands out most; a screenshot alone doesn't prove the strip scrolls like a slideshow.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: architectural editorial photograph of [SUBJECT: a contemporary interior with warm timber cabinetry and pale stone], soft daylight, restrained cream and walnut palette, realistic material detail, straight verticals, no text or graphics
entries.composition: five separate interior images across the upper page with a larger central frame; use code for opacity differences, image sizing, bronze details, and oversized lower headline

manta.take: Borrow the two-line headline, its second line pushed right, at that giant size, and a small strip of images above it as the page's preview. Not the cream-and-bronze luxury look or the big empty spaces, which the brand sheet refuses as too precious (brand sheet §1); Manta's opening section is loud, on turquoise.

mmm-infra.take: Cream and bronze, a giant slogan and 'Est. 2015' make a polished studio the brand, which is the established-consultancy voice Mark turned down (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: Zuno - Orange Workspace
entries.description: A white landing page with a bold black headline, a grey line of text under it, and two buttons (one outlined, one solid orange with small square marks at its corners) above a large screenshot of the product in a soft peach-to-orange gradient frame. The screenshot is a project-management dashboard: a menu of icons and labels down the left, four number cards, an orange line chart and a recent-activity list. Orange is the main accent, against black text, white and grey surfaces and light grey card edges; the number cards also carry small green and purple icons.
entries.note: Back up a short promise with one big view of the real product; the warm frame makes the dashboard stand out while the page itself stays white.

entries.composition: center headline and paired CTAs above a wide dashboard built in code or supplied as a real screenshot; place only the warm texture behind the dashboard frame

manta.take: Borrow a short promise above one real view of the product, with the compare table as the proof in the opening section. Not a single orange element: orange backgrounds and the peach frame are the Hostelworld look the brand sheet walls off (§12), and the buttons with little corner marks break its corner rounding (§10).

mmm-infra.take: Software-product chrome, a dashboard, 'Start Free' and 'Log In', has no place on a brochure site with no bespoke software (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: Royal Gambit - Chess Still Life
entries.description: A dark opening section for a chess club: a photo of wooden chess pieces, dark and light, on a chequered board, dramatically lit against near-black, with one dark piece knocked over on its side. A large old-style headline (letters with little feet), "The Home of Modern Chess Masters", sits on the dark left side, with a short paragraph in a plain font, two buttons (one outlined, one filled white), and a row of three figures at the bottom right (members, tournaments, grandmasters trained). A thin plain menu and an outlined "Sign Up" button run along the top.
entries.note: Let the photo of the object fill the whole section, and keep the left half dark so the text can sit there. The contrast between materials — polished wood against black — is what makes it feel expensive.

entries.composition: full-bleed background with white serif heading and paired CTAs on the left; reserve a quiet lower-right band for statistics rendered in HTML

manta.take: Dark luxury photography is a look the brand sheet refuses (brand sheet §1). The piece worth taking: the three figures separated by thin lines along the bottom edge of the opening section, used as a line of facts.

mmm-infra.take: Dark luxury photography with a 'Sign Up' button and a row of big counts is polished and corporate, and this site holds no counts and may invent none (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: Sakura Studio - Art Gallery
entries.description: A white page for an art school, with a pink flower logo, a top menu and a pink rectangular "Sign Up" button. Four figures stack down the left side (500+ Students Trained, 20+ Expert Instructors, 50+ Weekly Workshops, 1000+ Artworks Created); on the right sit three small illustrated landscapes (a pagoda by a canal, a mountain valley, a temple garden, heavy with pink-purple blossom) with a black "Explore More" button under the third. After a big white gap, a huge heavy black headline, "CREATIVE SPACE / FOR ARTISTS", runs across two lines, with a short grey line of text tucked under the first line on the left.
entries.note: Separate the colourful strip of art from the giant headline with an unusually large white gap. The pictures feel like a storybook, while the page's layout feels grand and magazine-like.
entries.source: cth9191/taste-vault, Chase's screenshot of Sakura Studio

entries.composition: three square illustrations in a row at upper-right, statistics rail at far left, and a large staggered two-line headline across the bottom; all typography and statistics remain in code

manta.take: Borrow three square place illustrations in a row as a strip that indexes the guides, with one button under the strip. Not the grand black headline or the extreme white gap. The painterly pictures are a style to try in the background-art trials (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059).

mmm-infra.take: Pastel storybook landscapes, a pink Sign Up button and a rail of boast figures (500+, 1000+) speak to hobby artists, not development-bank staff, and Mark holds no counts to fill such a rail (brand sheet §1).

entries.title: Synthos - AI Workspace
entries.description: A white software landing page puts a large black headline ("The AI Workspace That Never Misses a Detail") beside a paragraph, two buttons, a row of overlapping profile photos and a star rating. Below, a wide band with rounded corners is filled with flowing streaks of shimmering purple-to-peach light, and holds three floating app panels (Project Overview in white, AI Insights in dark, Upcoming Focus in white) joined by dotted arrows.
entries.note: Use a wide lower band to explain how the product works in three steps. The purple and peach are a deliberate choice in this reference; keep them when you are explicitly copying this look, even though the vault's general never-list discourages purple gradients.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
