entries.composition: headline left and explanation with CTAs right above a wide rounded artwork panel; build three contrasting product cards and their connecting arrows separately in code

manta.take: The purple-to-peach glow is the generic startup look, refused by the brand sheet (brand sheet §1) and by the House DNA never-list. The piece worth taking: three connected panels explaining a three-step flow (search, compare, hand over).

mmm-infra.take: Sign-up and log-in buttons, a star rating from "1000+ reviews" and purple AI-dashboard panels are software-product chrome; a brochure site has no accounts, and Mark has no reviews to show (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: AMBIENTICA - Shaping Spaces
entries.description: A white page for an interior design studio. A huge bold two-line headline, "SHAPING / SPACES", has a single small photo of a warm-toned living room sitting to the right of the first line, with the second line pushed right beneath it. A small "INTERIOR DESIGN STUDIO" label sits above the headline and a plain capitals menu runs along the top; a short paragraph and a black rectangular button sit at the bottom left. The location and founding year sit in small thin capitals just below the second line, on the right.
entries.note: Give the photo a deliberate gap beside the headline instead of using it as a background. The big lettering carries the identity; the warm room is the only real colour.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: editorial photograph of [SUBJECT: a contemporary living room with sculptural cream seating, copper pendant lights and warm recessed lighting], natural materials, warm neutral palette, soft daylight, straight architectural perspective, no text
entries.composition: single rectangular interior image upper-right next to the first oversized headline line; second line offset right below; small supporting copy and a wide black CTA at lower-left

manta.take: Borrow one photo set into a deliberate gap beside the first headline line, with the second line offset beneath it. Not the white gallery-like background, the extreme empty space or the plain modern font; Manta sets it in Quicksand (the brand's rounded font) on turquoise.

mmm-infra.take: One photograph set beside the headline on a white page, with one plain button at the bottom, is the shape for a homepage that leads with Mark: his photo where the room is, "Get in touch" where "Book a consultation" is (brand sheet §5). Not the giant capitals "SHAPING SPACES": a slogan that big speaks as a studio, not as one man introducing himself (§5).

entries.title: Stardust - Pixel Light
entries.description: A dark opening section filled with diagonal streaks of warm orange and cool blue light, seen through a coarse grid of square pixels, like a blurred photo at low resolution. Small typewriter-style text (every letter the same width) and a huge headline in the same style ("Infrastructure for AI Intelligent Systems") sit at the bottom left over the darkest part, with a menu along the top and an outlined case-study card, holding a small picture of a glowing flower, floating at the upper right. The colour is all hot orange against cold blue-black, with every button and label in white on see-through.
entries.note: Use the same pixel texture on both the picture and the big lettering. Put the case-study card in a quieter upper-right patch of the sweeping light.
vocabulary: diagonal orange and blue light trails
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: abstract long-exposure light trails suggesting [SUBJECT: energy moving through a network], bright amber-orange diagonals and cool blue streaks on a near-black ground, visible fine square pixel-grid texture, luminous bloom, quieter lower-left zone for type and upper-right zone for a card, no text or UI
entries.composition: full-bleed pixel-textured artwork; set headline and copy lower-left and one compact case-study card upper-right in HTML; keep border and type rendering crisp

manta.take: Pixel-textured light trails on black is processed, AI-made atmosphere, on a dark night background used without the limits the brand sheet sets for night grounds (§2). The piece worth taking: the outlined floating case-study card in the quiet corner.

mmm-infra.take: Pixelated orange-and-blue light on black is AI-startup atmosphere, far from any background Mark floated (white, a muted colour, blueprint paper or a legal pad), despite its "Infrastructure" headline (brand sheet §2).

entries.title: DRONE - Mapping OS
entries.description: A dark page for a drone-technology company, with a huge white "MAPPING-OS" name across the top and, below it, a night-vision style image of a glowing person beside a vehicle, lit by a bright cone of light. Around the image are cockpit-instrument style markings: a height ruler down the left, orange crosshair lines with latitude and longitude readouts, the outline of a country's coast, and a status line with "ACTIVE" in orange. A "Geospatial Awareness" heading with a ® mark and a paragraph sit at the bottom right.
entries.note: Treat the map, the photo and the instrument markings as one single picture. This is a design reference; its place names and sensor labels are made-up sample content.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: stylized thermal-camera image of [SUBJECT: a vehicle and standing figure in a dark landscape], near-black olive shadows with bright white heat silhouettes and subtle sensor grain, subject concentrated lower-left, no measurements, map labels, grids, or text
entries.composition: huge heading across top; thermal artwork lower-left, vector map contour through center-right, and compact explanation lower-right; implement grid, rulers, coordinates and crosshairs in SVG or CSS

manta.take: Dark instrument panel, typewriter-style readout text (every letter the same width) and orange crosshairs: the brand has no such font (brand sheet §4), the orange sits close to the line the brand sheet walls off (§12), and the dark night background is used without limit. The piece worth taking: nothing beyond the headline running the full width above the picture.

mmm-infra.take: Night-vision surveillance, crosshairs and coordinate readouts read as defence technology, a cold machine look against a site where the individual is the brand (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: DRONE - Thermal Specimen
entries.description: A black-and-white thermal-camera photo of a desert landscape fills most of the page, with bracket boxes marking glowing human heat shapes (labelled with an ID, distance in km and compass bearing) and a crosshair in the middle. Huge black headlines frame the image: "( THERMAL RECONNAISSANCE )" above and a giant "TRS-01" model name below. A specs table on a pale grey panel runs down the left (System, Sensor, Platform, Mode, Target and so on) and a column of system tags runs down the right. The page is white with black type; the photo carries white overlay text ("Observation System"), and an orange button sits below at the bottom right.
entries.note: Frame a large sensor-style picture with magazine-like columns of specifications. Keep the order of importance and the measurement wording, but don't treat the mock-up's specs as real facts.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: grayscale infrared-style visualization of [SUBJECT: a rugged desert valley with a few distant bright silhouettes], dark rocky terrain, high-contrast white thermal signatures, subtle camera grain, elevated wide view, no brackets, captions, measurements, or interface
entries.composition: large central landscape panel between a pale specification sidebar and narrow right legend; headline above and cropped product identifier below; create all labels and markers in code

manta.take: Borrow the left specification column — a table of labels and values on thin lines — as the model for the facts column of the comparison view. Not the black-and-white sensor imagery, the typewriter-style font or the safety-orange button.

mmm-infra.take: The specs table on a pale panel, labels left and values right on thin rules, is a calm way to show Mark's record at a glance (roles, institutions, sectors, regions), all taken from his CV and none invented (brand sheet §5). Not the rest: the thermal surveillance photo, the crosshairs, the typewriter-style lettering and the orange button make it defence hardware, not a person (§5).

entries.title: ROOTED - Textile Landscape
entries.description: A white page for a reforestation charity: a small label marked with a green square ("GLOBAL REFORESTATION INITIATIVE") above a large bold headline on the left, and a short paragraph with an olive button on the right. A row of seven grey partner logos sits above a wide photo of a sunlit mountain range falling into pine forest, printed with a visible woven-canvas texture and with its bottom-right corner cut off diagonally.
entries.note: Give nature pictures a surface you can almost feel, like fabric, then repeat the picture's cut-off corner on the button. Closest to the Printed Paper Texture collection, because of that printed, touchable look.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: landscape of [SUBJECT: a mountain ridge above dense forest] reproduced on coarse woven natural canvas, visible linen weave across sky and terrain, ochre sunlight and deep olive forest, warm muted earth palette, wide composition, no words or logos
entries.composition: wide landscape panel below a split headline-and-copy row and muted partner strip; clip the bottom-right corner with CSS to echo the CTA geometry

manta.take: Borrow the top of a guide page: headline and text split left and right above a wide picture of the place, and one button, with the picture redrawn in Manta's own illustration style. Not the cut-off corner or the olive button; the canvas texture is one to try in the background-art trials (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059).

mmm-infra.take: A wide, warm photograph of a real place under a split headline, printed with a faint canvas grain so it feels like a print rather than a stock photo, suits the refreshed images Mark wants, with a real project site or one of his own LinkedIn photographs in place of the mountains (brand sheet §6). Not the row of partner logos, since Mark holds none and none may be invented, and not the "global movement" mission voice, which tips into the advocacy Mark rules out (§6).

entries.title: SAKURA - Cosmic Tree
entries.description: A wide picture panel, framed by white margins, shows a single blossoming cherry tree on a dark rocky mound, wrapped in glowing blue and amber light trails and drifting pink petals against a black night sky. Below it, a large old-style headline (letters with little feet), "Create Smarter With Intelligent AI Assistance", sits on the left with the words "Intelligent AI" in pink, and a short paragraph and an outlined "VIEW CASE STUDIES" button sit on the right. The top menu on white is simple: a black name and links in the same old-style font, and an outlined button with pink corner marks.
entries.note: Pair a lavish glowing plant picture with a restrained white, magazine-like frame. The headline sits below the artwork, so the generated image doesn't need a headline built into it.
vocabulary: black image stage on white page
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: cinematic fantasy artwork of [SUBJECT: a flowering cherry tree rooted on a small rock], pink luminous blossoms and drifting petals, blue and peach light filaments crossing deep navy space, intricate bark, centered composition, no words, labels, or interface
entries.composition: large inset wide image directly below the navigation; serif headline below-left and supporting copy with a bracketed CTA below-right; pink accents stay in HTML and CSS

manta.take: A glowing AI-made plant picture is flat, textureless computer-render junk, and old-style lettering with little feet fails the brand's font rules (brand sheet §4). The piece worth taking: picture first, headline below it — a guide-page order where the scene leads.

mmm-infra.take: A glowing AI-made cherry tree in streaks of light on black is the startup glow none of Mark's floated backgrounds (white, muted, blueprint, legal pad) comes near (brand sheet §2).

entries.title: Bloomy.ai - Illustrated Paris
entries.description: A painterly illustration of Paris — blossom trees, a stone bridge, the Seine and a hazy Eiffel Tower, in lavender, pink and cyan — fills the page behind a rounded menu bar across the top, a large old-style headline ("Create Smarter With Intelligent AI Assistance", with "Intelligent AI" in violet), a one-line description and a rounded input box with drop-down menus for app type and AI model. The colours are pastel throughout, with a black pill-shaped "Build Free" button and other black buttons for contrast.
entries.note: Let an illustrated city set the scene while a real input box floats in its open sky. The particular pastel colours are a deliberate choice for this reference.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: pastel animation-background painting of [SUBJECT: Paris along the Seine with bridges and the Eiffel Tower], cherry blossoms framing the left edge, turquoise river, lavender and powder-blue buildings, soft cream sky covering the upper half, dreamy spring daylight, no words or interface
entries.composition: full-bleed city illustration anchors the bottom and edges; centered headline and a real translucent input panel sit in the calm upper-middle sky; keep navigation and all controls in code

manta.take: Borrow the homepage's opening section in one frame: an illustrated place scene rising from the bottom, the search box floating in its open sky, the water turquoise. Not the pastel-lavender colours, the painterly rendering or the pill-shaped menu — Manta's menu is a dark blue-green bar (brand sheet §2).

mmm-infra.take: A pastel painted Paris behind an AI app-builder prompt box, a Sign In link and a Build Free button is software-product chrome on a fairy-tale picture; a brochure site has no accounts or input tools (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: NEBULA - Luminous Flower
entries.description: A dark blue-green opening section holds a large glassy flower on the right, lit in blue and amber, with streaks of shimmering light crossing the frame diagonally. On the left, a short paragraph sits above a white headline in a plain modern font, "Create Smarter With Intelligent AI Assistance", with "Intelligent AI" in slanted cyan old-style lettering; a simple menu runs along the top and an outlined "GET STARTED" button sits in the corner.
entries.note: Use one recognisable living subject to give abstract light trails something to focus on. Keep the dark lower-left area for all the text.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: cinematic close view of [SUBJECT: one iridescent flower on a slender stem], translucent metallic petals glowing warm amber at the center, blue and peach light filaments crossing a deep navy void, flower on right, left and lower-left dark and quiet for text, no words or interface
entries.composition: full-bleed image with the flower right; supporting copy above the large lower-left headline; navigation and corner-mark CTA overlay the dark top edge

manta.take: Dark glowing threads of light are the AI-glow look the brand sheet refuses as generic startup (brand sheet §1). The piece worth taking: one living subject on the right that gives the whole picture a focal point — the mascot's job in the wave of the opening section.

mmm-infra.take: A glassy glowing flower in light streaks on a near-black ground is AI-product atmosphere, nowhere near the white, muted, blueprint or legal-pad grounds Mark floated (brand sheet §2).

entries.title: ROOT&SOIL - Golden Fields
entries.description: A landing page for a soil-health farming brand: a pale blush-pink top area fades into a photo, running to the page edges, of golden rolling hills, scattered rust-orange autumn trees and a hazy dusk sky. A large centred headline, "Every Harvest Begins With Healthy Soil" (with "Healthy Soil" in burnt orange), sits above two outlined buttons with bracket marks at their corners, with a small label and the menu above. A row of partner logos runs along the bottom edge over the grass.
entries.note: Use the sky as the page background, so the landscape flows into the text with no visible edge to the picture. A warm countryside version of the Vast Misty Landscape collection.
vocabulary: low horizon and pale peach sky
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: wide cinematic photograph of [SUBJECT: rolling golden grassland with scattered autumn trees], terracotta foliage and amber grasses, soft hazy peach sky covering the upper half, warm low-angle sunlight, gentle layered hills and quiet center sky, no text or logos
entries.composition: full-bleed landscape with horizon below the centered heading and paired CTAs; softly blend the sky into the warm page ground and place real partner marks along the lower foreground

manta.take: Borrow the sky becoming the page background so the scene has no top edge, and one warm word in the headline as the only accent colour. Not the photo, which would be redrawn as illustration, nor the buttons with corner brackets, which break the brand sheet's corner rounding (§10).

mmm-infra.take: A pale warm ground that melts into the picture with no edge is a calm way to land after the opening animation: the aqueduct's landscape could dissolve into the page this way, with one quiet line above it (brand sheet §6). Not the row of partner logos, since Mark holds none and none may be invented, and not two bracketed buttons: one plain "Get in touch" is the single action (§6).

entries.title: DRONE - See to Sea
entries.description: A drone-surveillance page with a black text menu on white and a huge black "SEE TO SEA" name across the width (with a ® mark and "Geospatial Awareness" at the right), then a wide aerial photo of a grey warship on dark ocean under an orange line. Overlays in white and orange typewriter-style text (every letter the same width) mark up the photo: tracking brackets, coordinates, confidence percentages, a "SWARM MESH" diagram of linked points, and a large "99.6%" track-continuity figure. Below, three numbered features (01, 02, 03) in big bold plain numerals each introduce a short heading and text.
entries.note: Set an enormous magazine-style headline against a busy, labelled sea photo. Group it with the other DRONE references as another section of the same design.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: top-down aerial photograph of [SUBJECT: a large vessel crossing deep teal open water], long white wake trailing to the right, crisp textured ocean, vessel stretching horizontally through center, no reticles, labels, diagrams, or text
entries.composition: huge headline above a wide ocean image; put orange rules, white tracking brackets, corner metadata, and a compact SVG relationship diagram over it; numbered body sections sit below

manta.take: Borrow the numbered sections under the image — 01, 02, 03, each with a title and one plain line — as the structure of the how-we-rank page. Not the labelled aerial photo, the tracking brackets or the typewriter-style readout text.

mmm-infra.take: A warship under tracking brackets, lock-on labels and a 99.6% figure is military surveillance, cold and impersonal, the opposite of meeting Mark (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: DRONE - Thermion Heatmap
entries.description: A white product page for a drone-mounted heat camera (TRS-01), split left and right: on the left, a pale grey "[TRS-01]" label, a bold headline ("Every degree is data"), a paragraph and an orange button; on the right, a large aerial heat map of buildings shading from blue to red, with scanner-style overlays — boxes around structures, coordinates, readouts, a compass and a scale bar. Below, a huge black "THERMION" name runs across beside a cropped close-up of the heat image showing a confidence percentage. Small typewriter-style capital labels and orange tags mark the buildings and people found on the map.
entries.note: Put the colourful analysis picture beside a quiet white column of explanation. Reuse the DRONE lettering and orange accents, while the heat map brings in colour that carries meaning.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: stylized false-color thermal map of [SUBJECT: a cluster of buildings and surrounding terrain seen from above], deep blue shadows, cyan transitions, green and yellow midtones, orange-red warm regions, fine sensor texture, no actual measurements, labels, markers, or interface
entries.composition: left white column with description and orange CTA; large heatmap right; build region outlines, compass, scale, telemetry and cropped bottom wordmark in code

manta.take: The fake-colour heat map, the orange block button and the typewriter-style status text break both the orange line the brand sheet walls off (§12) and its font rules (§4). The piece worth taking: a calm white column of explanation beside a loud picture is the brand sheet's loud-and-calm split (§1), done as a layout.

mmm-infra.take: A heat-camera map of buildings with people tagged inside, a Shop button and readout text sells surveillance hardware, nothing a personal advisor's brochure can borrow (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: DRONE - From Above
entries.description: A full-page aerial photo of a desert canyon with military-style vehicles kicking up dust, overlaid with a faint grid of lines, an orange aiming bracket around one vehicle and an orange "TARGET LOCKED" tag. A huge white headline in a plain modern font, "FROM ABOVE / TO AHEAD", sits across the terrain with its second line pushed right, below a menu (DRONE / PRODUCTS / ABOUT / CAREERS / SEARCH). A typewriter-style data list (DATUM / PROJECTION / TERRAIN) and a "Terrain Intelligence" section sit below, and a large "G-01" model name anchors the bottom right corner.
entries.note: Lay the giant headline on the same grid as the terrain photo and the instrument markings. Keep this with the DRONE map, heat-camera and sea references as one matching family.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: oblique aerial photograph of [SUBJECT: vehicles traveling along a winding road through rugged arid hills], muted brown terrain, dark cinematic exposure, distinct road running diagonally, spacious upper-right terrain for white headline, no grid, markers, labels, or text
entries.composition: full-bleed terrain image with large staggered headline across upper-right; overlay thin CSS/SVG grid and a small orange annotation; add compact lower copy and cropped product ID in HTML

manta.take: Full-page aerial photography with a grid on top: the brand sheet keeps photos to listings only (brand sheet §9). The piece worth taking: the giant headline, its lines offset, laid on the picture's own grid.

mmm-infra.take: Armoured vehicles in a canyon with a "TARGET LOCKED" tag is a defence page; for staff at development banks it reads as threat, not as a calm, experienced advisor (brand sheet §1).

entries.title: Stillpage
entries.description: A warm off-white page with faint dashed grid lines and a paper-grain texture holds a bold headline in a plain modern font, "The AI workspace for one thing at a time", with "workspace" in orange. Below it, latitude and longitude figures in typewriter-style text sit at the left and right edges, and a tree on a rolling hill stands in the middle of the lower half, printed in halftone (the tiny-dot texture of old newspaper photos) with red, green and yellow dots, as if the colour printing had slipped out of line. A white rounded menu box, a dark logo mark, a dark pill-shaped "Get Started" button and a row of grey partner logos (Coinbase, OpenAI, Public, Perp) complete the layout.
entries.note: The template for the whole collection: paper, coordinates, one word in a hot, ember-like colour.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: a lone [SUBJECT: tree with autumn foliage] on a grassy hill, rendered as a vintage halftone CMYK print with coarse visible dot grid and chromatic misregistration in greens/oranges/magentas, warm cream paper sky occupying the upper two-thirds as negative space, flat vintage print finish, subtle paper grain
entries.composition: full-bleed page ground; halftone sky occupies the top two-thirds as the text zone; nav floats in a white pill over it

manta.take: Borrow the warm paper background, close to the pale sand page colour; the headline on the pale upper area with the scene rising from the bottom edge; one accent word. Not the typewriter-style coordinates or the orange. The halftone dots are one to try in the background-art trials, kept faint enough to disappear behind the text, as your background principles ask (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059).

mmm-infra.take: The warm off-white paper with a faint grain and thin dashed rules is the nearest thing in this batch to the paper grounds Mark floated, and could be tried as a quieter cousin of the legal pad or blueprint paper (brand sheet §2). Not the orange accent word, since Mark has chosen no such colour, nor the typewriter-style coordinates, the AI-product wording or the partner logos he does not hold (§2).

entries.title: SPADE
entries.description: A pale sage-green panel on a white page carries a large bold black headline, "The data & AI platform for modern finance", with a drawing of what looks like a coffee-cup lid, made of lines like the height lines on a relief map, overlapping its bottom. Two outlined boxes of typewriter-style data (a transaction ID, and an address with latitude and longitude) sit on the left, and a white transaction card with a Starbucks logo, time stamp and dollar amount overlaps the drawing on the right. Thin ruler tick marks run down both page edges; centred body text in dark green-black sits below.
entries.note: Use little margin notes of data — a transaction ID, coordinates — as decoration that also states real facts.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: [SUBJECT: an arrowhead-shaped stone] illustrated purely with fine topographic contour lines, single dark-green ink on pale sage-green paper, engraving-like line density describing 3D form, generous empty paper around it, technical-drawing precision, no shading fills
entries.composition: isolated illustration placed center-right within a pale sage page, surrounded by mono data-callout chips; page ground matches the paper color so it floats in the layout, not in a frame

manta.take: Borrow an illustration floating on the page background with no frame, with small fact labels around it — a guide-page device. Not the relief-map line drawing, the engraved style the brand sheet closed when the logo was chosen (§8), nor the sage background or the typewriter-style labels.

mmm-infra.take: The thin ruler ticks running down both page edges: a quiet drafting-table detail that could frame a blueprint-paper background, one of the grounds Mark floated (brand sheet §2). Not the rest: the AI-finance headline, the sage panel, the contour drawing and the transaction cards are software-product chrome, and the data labels would add the clutter Mark called "much too busy" (§6).

entries.title: Halftone Sails Collage
entries.description: A grid of unequal panels mixes two photo crops of tall-ship sails against grey sky with halftone panels (the tiny-dot texture of old newspaper photos: black dots on cream, cream dots on black, and dark dots on tan), a solid dark block holding one white triangle, and a warm tan strip along the bottom with ruler ticks and numbers. One sail photo has a technical drawing on top — a circle, crossing lines and a small ring, like a rigging diagram. The colours are sepia, cream, near-black and warm tan; the only type is small typewriter-style numbers and corner alignment marks.
entries.note: A pure old-print-style collage: the texture itself is the design.
entries.source: cth9191/taste-vault, Chase's screenshot of an unrecorded site
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: archival photograph of [SUBJECT: schooner sails against sky] arranged as a print collage: photo panels alternating with fields of pure halftone dots in cream and near-black, hard rectangular blocks, muted sepia-slate palette, thin compass/geometry line overlay on the photo, vintage newspaper reproduction quality
entries.composition: the collage IS the page ground - full-bleed blocks; text sits on the cream fields between photo panels

manta.take: Take the cream blocks and dark blue-green blocks as the only two backgrounds. The old-print collage texture, which is the whole design here, is one to try in the background-art trials (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059).

mmm-infra.take: A wall of halftone blocks, photo crops and ruler numbers is exactly the stacked, busy surface Mark rejected in MacGeorge's site, with no room for Mark himself (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: MONOLITH
entries.description: A dark studio site: a bold white headline in a plain modern font, "Every Great Structure Begins with a Blueprint", on the left with a white "Schedule a call" button below it, and a black-and-white photo of a classical Greek temple's columns and roof, made of fine scattered dots, filling the right side of a rounded dark-grey panel. A footer below carries a small logo, a one-line tagline and three columns of links, then an oversized "MONOLITH" name cut off by the bottom of the page. The colours are only black, white and mid-grey, with visible grain across the photo.
entries.note: A classical subject, a machine-made dot texture, and a name running off the edge of the page.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: [SUBJECT: Parthenon-style classical temple facade] emerging from darkness, rendered in heavy black-and-white bitmap dither, dramatic side light raking across columns, right side of frame lit / left dissolving to pure black, monumental low-angle composition, machine-processed texture
entries.composition: right-half hero against black; left half stays near-black as the headline column; giant wordmark overlaps the bottom edge

manta.take: Borrow the giant name cut off by the footer's bottom edge, in white on the dark blue-green night background. Not the dotted Parthenon, the studio-black opening section or a page that is dark all the way down.

mmm-infra.take: One plain headline about structures beside one picture of old stonework, with a single "Schedule a call" button as the only ask: close to Mark's aqueduct and his one action. Not the black studio page and dotted grain, which are colder than any ground Mark floated (white, muted, blueprint, legal pad; brand sheet §2), and not the giant name cut off by the footer, which makes the firm the brand (§5).

entries.title: Castle
entries.description: A split waitlist page on an off-white background: on the left, a logo, a large old-style headline (letters with little feet), "The waitlist is now open", a line of text under it, an email field and a dark "Join Waitlist" button. On the right, a tall castle tower (it also reads as a chess rook) made of coarse black-and-white dots, cut out against the same off-white and running off the top, right and bottom edges.
entries.note: A waitlist cut down to the essentials; the dotted picture carries all the personality.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: [SUBJECT: medieval stone castle tower] as a 1-bit bitmap illustration, pure black pixels on white, coarse ordered-dither shading, chunky pixel-art edges at high resolution, isolated on white with hard silhouette, woodcut-meets-Macintosh energy
entries.composition: isolated illustration on the right half of a white page; form column left; the hard silhouette gives text clean air

manta.take: A picture made of pure black-and-white dots carries the whole personality, far from the brand's colours (§3). The piece worth taking: a waitlist cut down to one field and one button — the single form field whose wording says what you get (brand sheet §12a).

mmm-infra.take: The calm split: an old-style headline and one action on an off-white page, with one strong picture on the other half running off the edges, which could be Mark's photograph or the aqueduct. Not the coarse black-and-white dot picture, and not the email waitlist box: the one action is getting in touch with Mark, not joining a list (brand sheet §1).

entries.title: Asterisk Login
entries.description: A login page: a white card on the left, set in from the edges on a dark grainy background, holds an asterisk mark above an old-style "Welcome Back!" heading (letters with little feet), email and password fields, a black Login button, and Google and X buttons. The right side is a heavily grained black-and-white photo of a person sitting on a grassy slope under a bright, cloudy sky, with a coarse grain and dot texture throughout.
entries.note: Treat the login like a magazine spread: form on the left, picture on the right.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: grainy black-and-white photograph of [SUBJECT: a person seated beneath a large tree], tonally inverted/solarized so foliage glows white against black sky, heavy film grain and noise, surreal negative-image mood, single human figure small in frame
entries.composition: right panel of a split-screen login; left form panel is pure white; image cropped hard at the split

manta.take: Borrow the login as a two-page spread: white form panel on the left, picture panel on the right cut off sharply at the split, with the picture in Manta's own illustration style. Not the grainy inverted photo, the old-style font or the asterisk mark.

mmm-infra.take: A sign-in page has no place on a brochure site with no accounts, shop or bespoke software (brand sheet §6), and the grainy black-and-white photo of a stranger says nothing about Mark.

entries.title: Dark Login (Floating Rock)
entries.description: A dark login page split in two. The left half is charcoal, with a four-pointed sparkle logo, a "Welcome Back!" heading in old-style lettering (with little feet on the letters), Google and Apple sign-in buttons, email and password boxes, and a light "Log In" button. The right half is a grainy black-and-white photo of a figure in a long coat standing on a rock, looking up at a huge chunk of rock floating in the air with plants growing on it, with mist along the bottom.
entries.note: The same half-form, half-picture login layout works in a dark version: a strange, dreamlike photo carries the whole mood so the form can stay plain.
entries.source: cth9191/taste-vault, Chase's screenshot of an unrecorded site
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: surreal black-and-white photograph: a massive [SUBJECT: inverted pyramid boulder] floating above a small human figure standing on a rock, heavy film grain, glowing white foliage spilling down dark cliff behind, single soft key light, dreamlike gravity-defying stillness
entries.composition: right panel of a split-screen on charcoal; centered subject with vignette; form panel left

manta.take: A charcoal login page is a dark night-time background, and the brand sheet (§2) names no place for one; the dreamlike black-and-white photo breaks brand sheet §9. The one piece worth keeping: the same split layout the asterisk-login reference has.

mmm-infra.take: A charcoal sign-in page with a dreamlike floating rock: a sign-in form the brochure site will never have (brand sheet §6), in a fantasy mood far from a practical infrastructure lawyer.

entries.title: CTGT (hero)
entries.description: A full-width aerial photo of a dark, jagged mountain ridge, with a pale, misty white sky filling the top half. The black headline "The New AI Standard" in a plain modern font sits centred in the empty sky, with a small "Learn more" link under it. The "CTGT" name and a small many-sided logo sit centred at the bottom edge, over the rock.
entries.note: One huge picture and very few words: the sheer size of the image makes the company feel important and sure of itself.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: vast aerial photograph of [SUBJECT: a jagged mountain ridge] in desaturated slate tones, surrounding peaks fading into pale mist, upper half of frame pure fog-white sky for headline space, epic quiet scale, no people, matte cinematic grade
entries.composition: full-bleed; fog-white upper half is the headline zone with tiny centered type; ridge fills the lower half

manta.take: Small centred text over a vast black-and-white misty scene is exactly the cold, clinical, look-how-serious-we-are feel the brand sheet (§1) names as the enemy. The one piece worth keeping: the logo alone, anchoring the bottom of the opening screen.

mmm-infra.take: A vast, cold mountain under a few words is built to make a company look big and sure of itself: the established-firm voice Mark rejects, with nothing of the man in it (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: CTGT (alt hero)
entries.description: A full-width photo of a green, rocky mountain ridge rising to the right, with its peaks disappearing into white fog at the top and the bottom of the page fading to black. On the left, in the pale fog, is a headline whose first words are black and the rest grey, a short paragraph, and one black rectangular button. A small line-drawn logo sits top left and a few menu links and an outlined button sit top right.
entries.note: A headline can stress its key words by making them darker and the rest lighter, without making anything bigger.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: moody photograph of [SUBJECT: sharp green mountain crags] with fog pouring over ridgelines, deep green-slate grade, left third of frame dissolving to soft white fog for text column, bottom fading to near-black, alpine gravitas
entries.composition: full-bleed; left third dissolves to fog-white for the text column; image darkens toward the bottom

manta.take: Take the two-tone headline, stressing words by darker and lighter colour rather than size, which Manta already does in its wordmark and can do in the dark blue-green and lagoon text on the pale sand page colour. Not the photograph, the fade into fog, or the darkening at the bottom.

mmm-infra.take: The two-tone headline, which could be set in the logo's own pair: the key words in logo blue or site text grey, the rest in the lighter panel grey (brand sheet §2, still open). Not the misty mountain, the fade to black, the spaced capitals in the menu or the Fortune 500 copy, which speaks as a firm (§5).

entries.title: Nexora
entries.description: A full-width photo of sea cliffs at sunset: a teal sky and sea, one glowing orange-red strip on the horizon, and a lone dark figure standing in a field of red flowers looking out to sea. A bold white headline, "AI That Works Like Your Best Team Member", sits on the left in the upper sky, with a short paragraph, a white rounded button and a "Watch Demo" link below it. A slim menu bar with logo, links and a rounded "Get Started Free" button runs along the top; three short feature labels with double-arrow markers and a "Scroll to Down" prompt run along the bottom edge.
entries.note: The colour tint of the whole photo can be the brand: one cool colour everywhere, broken by a single warm glow.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: cinematic photograph of [SUBJECT: coastal cliffs meeting the sea] at dusk, entire scene graded deep teal, single ember-red sun glow at the horizon line, field of dark wildflowers with red blooms in foreground, lone distant silhouette optional, heavy atmospheric haze, matte film finish
entries.composition: full-bleed dusk scene; headline sits top-left on the darkened sky; feature ticker runs along the bottom

manta.take: A teal world with one glowing warm horizon shows brand sheet §3's rule, warm colours for doing and cool colours for reading, in a single picture, with the sunset sitting where the coral button goes. Not the photograph, and not white text on teal (brand sheet §2: the dark blue-green on turquoise). The row of feature labels along the bottom is a second thing worth taking.

mmm-infra.take: A stock-style AI product opening, a stranger at sunset with "Get Started Free" buttons and a feature ticker, says nothing about Mark, and the lone-figure-at-the-cliff mood is a sales pitch, not a person (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: The Prompting Company
entries.description: A full-screen photo of the top of an orange Golden Gate Bridge tower rising out of fog into a hazy blue sky. Above the headline sits a small "Backed by Y Combinator" line with an orange Y badge; below it are a centred headline in large old-style lettering (with little feet on the letters), "Get discovered & used by ChatGPT", a plain subheading, and one rounded "Start free trial" button. Menu links and two more buttons sit in a slim top bar, and a small label floats near the bottom over the fog.
entries.note: A softer take on the big-photo opening screen: elegant old-style lettering and gentle fog in place of plain type and harsh rock.
entries.source: cth9191/taste-vault, Chase's screenshot of The Prompting Company
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: soft photograph of [SUBJECT: suspension bridge towers] emerging from a sea of fog, airy pastel blue-pink sky occupying upper two-thirds, warm rust-red structure as the only saturated element, gentle morning light, serene monumental calm
entries.composition: full-bleed; pastel sky upper two-thirds carries a centered serif headline; subject rises from the bottom edge

manta.take: Take a warm-coloured subject rising from the bottom edge into a pale sky that holds the centred headline: one warm object in a cool setting. Not the old-style lettering, the photo fog, or the rounded buttons.

mmm-infra.take: A real piece of infrastructure rising from the bottom edge into a calm, muted sky that holds one centred old-style headline and one button: the same arrangement could hold a photograph from Mark's projects, or the aqueduct once the opening animation has built it. Not the Y Combinator badge, the sign-in and free-trial buttons or the startup copy, which are product chrome on a site that sells nothing (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: Climora
entries.description: An opening screen with a dark teal sky. On the left sit a five-star "Accuracy & Reliability" line, a white headline in a plain modern font, "Real-time climate intelligence for every smart decision.", a short paragraph, and two buttons (solid amber and dark grey). Orange sunset clouds fill the whole bottom of the screen and rise highest on the right, covered in a fine grid of tiny number-like characters so the clouds look like they are made of data. A menu bar with logo, links, a "Sign In" and an amber "Get Started" button runs across the top.
entries.note: The clouds are the data: the texture of the picture itself tells the story of what the product does.
vocabulary: clouds rendered from amber binary characters
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: towering cumulus [SUBJECT: clouds] at golden hour against a dark teal sky, cloud surfaces rendered from thousands of tiny amber monospace binary digits (0s and 1s) varying in density with the light, photographic composition, data-as-material texture readable up close, dark moody upper sky for headline
entries.composition: full-bleed dark sky; headline left on the darkest area; data-clouds fill the lower right

manta.take: Amber clouds on a dark teal sky are the brand's night colours, the dark blue-green with amber, so this fits only as the background of a rewards screen (brand sheet §2, §3: amber is for rewards only). Not the texture of tiny characters, the golden button or the five-star badge.

mmm-infra.take: Clouds made of tiny numbers, a five-star badge, a sign-in button and amber "Get Started" buttons are data-product chrome, busy where Mark wants calm (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: ASCII Web Section
entries.description: A white finance web page, shown as a screen recording on a black frame. Under a heading in old-style lettering (with little feet on the letters), "Custom Market Predictions across the globe", the left side holds a large globe drawn entirely from tiny blue 0s and 1s, and the right side holds a paragraph, an on/off switch, and a dotted panel with small profile photos and a "See the complete market analysis" link. Below a row of category tabs, rows of cards repeat the same tiny-character drawings (a swirling circle, an eye-like shape, a head and shoulders, an S-shaped ribbon), next to cards with old-style titles, 1D/7D/1M time buttons and "Expand" or "Copy link" buttons.
entries.note: Proof that the trick works on a white page too: pictures built out of tiny typed characters (ASCII art) used as the product's own artwork.
entries.source: cth9191/taste-vault, Chase's screenshot of an unrecorded site
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: [SUBJECT: a globe] illustrated entirely from small blue monospace characters on pure white, character density forming continents and shading, sparse and airy, technical-poetic, crisp legible glyphs, generous white margin
entries.composition: inline illustration inside a white editorial card grid - NOT a background; the art floats beside copy at partial width

manta.take: An illustration set beside the text at part width inside a calm white grid of cards, for screens with nothing in them yet and for feature cards, never as a background. Not the tiny-character drawings or the old-style headings.

mmm-infra.take: The white grid of hairline-ruled cards with old-style titles could carry Mark's 24 articles and presentations as a quiet list Angélique adds a card to (brand sheet §6). Not the pictures made of 0s and 1s, the time buttons, the tabs or the toggle: finance-product chrome that adds the busyness Mark rejected.

entries.title: IGLOO
entries.description: A full-screen 3D computer image of an igloo on a snowy mountain slope, all in cold blue-greys except for bright white light glowing through the blocks at the top and back of the igloo. A chunky, pixel-style "IGLOO" name and a couple of short lines of text sit in the empty top-left corner. The igloo sits right of centre, leaving most of the picture as open, empty mountainside.
entries.note: One lit object, done as a live 3D scene in the browser: a single glowing thing in a world of one colour pulls every eye to it.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: monochrome 3D render of [SUBJECT: an igloo of glowing ice blocks] on an endless snow plain, translucent blocks lit from within (cool white glow), overcast gray-blue palette, soft volumetric snow haze, distant dunes of snow, single hero object composition, photoreal CG finish
entries.composition: full-bleed monochrome scene; single glowing object right-center; headline and mono labels sit top-left in the haze

manta.take: A one-colour 3D computer render: not illustration, and not Manta's colours. Only the idea of one lit object in an otherwise empty world carries over.

mmm-infra.take: A single built structure, made of visible blocks, as the only lit subject in a quiet one-colour scene: the place the opening animation could end, with the finished aqueduct standing alone before the dissolve to the homepage. Not the live 3D scene, the snow world or the pixel lettering: the build that must land exactly on the logo stays hand-built SVG (brand sheet §7), and a 3D engine is bespoke software on a brochure site (§6).

entries.title: Juris
entries.description: The right half of the page is an old oil-painting figure of Lady Justice in flowing pink and cream robes, holding scales and a sword, against a painted blue sky with clouds. The left half, on the same blue, has a small "New: Multi-Jurisdiction Support" label, a white headline "Legal intelligence for Everyone." with the last word in slanted old-style lettering, a short paragraph, and a white chat box with an attach button, a location tag, a microphone and a dark round send button. The menu links sit in a pale see-through strip at the top, with a black "Start With Juris" button.
entries.note: A centuries-old painting makes a legal AI product feel human, and lends it that old art's weight and trust.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only

entries.composition: right two-thirds of the hero; the painting's sky continues into the page background so the left text column sits on the same blue; input bar overlaps the bottom

manta.take: Take the painting's sky carrying on into the page background so the text column sits on the same blue, and the search box overlapping the lower edge of the opening screen. Not the Renaissance figure, the frosted-glass input box, or white text on blue (brand sheet §2).

mmm-infra.take: Lady Justice beside an AI chat box is a legal product's cliché, not a person: Mark's legal background should show in him and his words, not in borrowed allegory (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: Break the Pattern
entries.description: Michelangelo's two almost-touching hands from "The Creation of Adam" fill a dusty slate-blue screen, with a visible canvas-cloth texture and clouds along the bottom. Thin dashed circles, one inside another, are centred on the meeting fingertips. Below the hands, centred, a small "Neuroscience-Backed" label sits over a large headline in old-style lettering (with little feet on the letters), "Break the Pattern. Rebuild Your Life.", with some words white and some grey, then a subheading and two rounded buttons in typewriter-style lettering.
entries.note: A famous old painting marked up with thin circles like a technical diagram, so the ancient image reads as something being studied.

entries.composition: full-bleed and slightly dimmed; centered serif headline sits directly on the canvas grain in the gap between the hands

manta.take: A classical painting under a canvas texture with circles drawn over it: the brand sheet (§8) has ruled out the old engraved-print look, and §9 leads with illustration. The one piece worth keeping: the headline placed in the empty gap inside the picture.

mmm-infra.take: Michelangelo's hands under "Break the Pattern. Rebuild Your Life." and a free-training button is a self-help campaign, the slogan-led tone Mark called an advocacy platform rather than a marketing vehicle (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: MARBLE
entries.description: A full-screen painted picture of a bright blue sky with white clouds, a small rocky island with a lighthouse, and a child in a red kayak paddling across a deep blue sea. Huge chunky white letters spelling "MARBLE" fill the sky, with the island's rocky peak rising in front of them. Below, an old-style subheading (with little feet on the letters) reads "An interactive world built to keep kids curious, not quiet", above a sign-up form with see-through name and email boxes and a red "Join our beta" button; the colours are sky and sea blues, white lettering and red for the kayak and button.
entries.note: The letters of the name can act as windows onto the illustrated world behind them.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only

entries.composition: full-bleed illustration; a giant wordmark masks into the sky; the calm water at the bottom holds form inputs

manta.take: Take a blue sea-and-island world with one red thing in it (the kayak, the main button), and the sign-up form sitting on calm water at the bottom. The painted storybook look is one to try in the background-art trials (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059); not the name's letters used as windows onto the picture, which brand sheet §5 forbids.

mmm-infra.take: A children's storybook world with a giant bubbly name and a beta sign-up is the opposite of an experienced advisor speaking to development-bank staff (brand sheet §1).

entries.title: Vitra
entries.description: A waitlist page split down the middle. The left half is pale grey fading to blue at the top, with a dark-green logo, a large dark-green headline in a plain modern font, "Good things are on the way.", a short line of text, an email box, a dark-green "Join Waitlist" button, and a row of five small profile photos with "Join 1200+ others". The right half is a warm painted picture of a young man in a blue shirt looking at his phone among tropical leaves and orange flowers, with a pale apartment building behind him that carries on faintly across the join into the left half.
entries.note: A picture on one side and calm, simple text on the other gives a page warmth without clutter.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: painterly illustration of [SUBJECT: a person reading on a balcony] surrounded by lush tropical foliage and orange flowers, warm evening light on a pale apartment building behind, gouache animation-background style, saturated greens with coral accents, composed for a right-side vertical panel
entries.composition: right vertical panel of a split layout; left panel is flat pale ground with text; illustration crops at the panel edge

manta.take: Take the split: a flat, pale text panel on the left and a picture panel on the right cut off at the page edge, with warm flowers as the accent, as art for first-time setup screens and screens with nothing in them yet. Not the large dark-green plain lettering, or the row of customer faces used as proof that others have joined; the painted look is one to try (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059).

mmm-infra.take: The building in the picture carrying on faintly across the join into the plain text panel: the aqueduct, or a photograph of one of Mark's projects, could fade behind his words the same way. Not the waitlist box or the row of faces with "Join 1200+ others": the one action is getting in touch with Mark (brand sheet §1), and no counts or endorsements may be invented.

entries.title: linq
entries.description: A full-screen hazy painted landscape (a misty lake, trees, a distant city skyline and glowing clouds) is darkened and fades to near-black at the bottom. A dark rounded phone-style panel showing a text-message chat with a voice note floats in the middle, above a large bold white headline in a plain modern font with dark boxes of highlight behind some of its words. A slim menu runs across the top, and a light "Try sandbox" button and a "Talk to an Expert" link sit at the bottom.
entries.note: A storybook painting turned dark: a painted world dimmed so the product's own screens stand out in front of it.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only

entries.composition: full-bleed but dimmed ~40% behind a centered UI mockup; headline overlays the darkest lower zone

manta.take: A painted world dimmed by about forty percent behind a picture of the product, on a dark page that runs on with no frame: the opposite of the loud, bright daytime opening screen in brand sheet §2. The one piece worth keeping: headline words with boxes of highlight behind them.

mmm-infra.take: A dimmed painted landscape behind a phone chat mock-up and "Try sandbox" buttons is developer-product chrome for software Mark does not sell (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: Nightlife, Refined
entries.description: A dark cocktail-bar web page, captured from a video (a "0:02" timer shows bottom left). The left side is near-black, with a small "Rated 5 stars by 2,000+ guests" badge, a large white headline, "Nightlife, Refined.", in lettering built from dots like an old electronic display, a short paragraph, a white rounded "Reserve a Table" button and a plain "Book Now" link. On the right, in front of a red-orange panel, a classical statue of a bearded man lit green holds a martini glass, with glowing orange and yellow letters and symbols scattered over his body like falling data.
entries.note: Dot-matrix lettering (letters built from dots) and a statue dusted with digital symbols: an ancient figure wired into a nightclub.
entries.source: cth9191/taste-vault, Chase's screenshot of an unrecorded site
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only

entries.composition: right-half figure against the red glow; left half falls to near-black for the headline; glyph rain bleeds toward center

manta.take: A deep red-and-black background counts as a warm background, the one thing brand sheet §12 flatly forbids, and dot-matrix lettering breaks brand sheet §4. The one piece worth keeping: nightlife is one of the night settings §2 names, so a nightlife opening screen on the dark blue-green is allowed — with the mascot, not a statue.

mmm-infra.take: A cocktail bar's red-and-black page, dot-matrix lettering and a statue holding a martini have nothing to say to development-bank staff choosing an advisor (brand sheet §1).

entries.title: YieldStream
entries.description: A near-black opening screen, captured from a video (a "0:05" timer shows bottom left). On the right is an old engraving-style drawing of a muscular winged angel with a halo, coloured in warm skin tones and blue, broken up by clusters of tiny typed characters and rainbow-edged glitch streaks. On the left sit a large off-white headline in old-style lettering (with little feet on the letters), "Yield aggregation reimagined from first principles", a short line of text and a rectangular outlined "Launch App" button, with small ringed planets in the lower left.
entries.note: An old engraving broken up with a digital glitch effect (datamosh: deliberately smeared, broken-up video), so the angel is literally "streaming".

entries.composition: right-half figure on near-black; serif headline owns the left; glitch streaks may cross into the text zone sparingly

manta.take: An engraving plus a glitch effect: the engraved look is one the brand sheet closed when the logo was chosen (§8), and the glitch piles a second heavy effect on top. Nothing here is worth keeping.

mmm-infra.take: A glitch-streaked angel on black for a crypto yield app is the crypto chrome and visual noise furthest from a calm personal-advisor site (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: Cogni
entries.description: A near-black opening screen with glowing bands of light sweeping in curves from the upper left down to the lower right, shading from green through white to blue. A small line, "AI-native. Built for what's next", sits above a large centred headline: "Intelligence That Moves" in a plain modern font, then "You Forward." in slanted old-style lettering that shades from green to blue. An old-style logo and plain menu links run across the top; a cream "See Our Work" button and a "Learn More" text link sit below the subheading.
entries.note: Swap the landscape for pure light: you get mood and atmosphere without showing any real place.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
