entries.composition: full-bleed; light trails sweep the lower-left; upper half stays near-black for a centered headline

manta.take: Streaks of light on black, like a long-exposure photo, are the same glowing "AI" look as the nebula and stardust references. The one piece worth keeping: the cream rounded button standing out as the only light object on a dark background.

mmm-infra.take: Glowing green-to-blue light streaks on black under "AI-native" are AI-product chrome, the polished-agency look Mark set himself against (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: Visora
entries.description: A cream-coloured page, most of it empty pale sky, with a large black headline in a plain modern font, "A Unified Platform for All Your Operations.", a short line of text and a small flat grey "Request a Demo" button in the upper left. A dark desert dune runs along only the bottom fifth of the screen, with a single silhouetted figure in a long dress or coat and a hat walking along its ridge. A menu bar runs across the top, and three social links sit on the dune in the bottom right.
entries.note: One figure, one dune, one headline: the sheer sense of size does all the work.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: minimal photograph of [SUBJECT: a lone figure walking along a desert dune ridge] at dusk, vast cream-white empty sky filling the top 70% for typography, dune shadows in deep brown-black, tiny human scale against emptiness, warm muted grade, meditative stillness
entries.composition: full-bleed; cream empty sky fills the top 70% as the text zone; dune and figure run along the bottom edge

manta.take: Take the cream empty sky as the space for text, with the scene along the bottom edge and one figure for scale; this cream only nearly matches the pale sand page colour. Not the photograph or the flat grey button. The brand's opening-screen background is turquoise, so this is the layout for a destination's opening screen, not the homepage.

mmm-infra.take: A warm cream ground, close to the muted colour or legal-pad yellow Mark floated, left mostly empty for the headline, with one low horizon along the bottom where the aqueduct could stand once it is built. Not the "Request a Demo" button, the log-in link or the platform copy, which speak as a software firm, not as Mark (brand sheet §5).

entries.title: Stillness
entries.description: An off-white page with a large black headline in old-style lettering (with little feet on the letters), "Meditation without the mysticism. Just the science. Just the practice.", with "the mysticism." in sage green, then a grey subheading and two rounded-corner buttons (dark green and outlined). The lower half of the first screen is a wide landscape built from small 3D blocks: blue back ridges, white peaks with coral bands, a blue river and clusters of green trees, running to the bottom and side edges. The menu is a plain logo, five text links and a dark green "Sign In" button.
entries.note: A calm meditation landscape built out of little digital blocks (voxels, like Minecraft): a digital material for a peaceful subject.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: [SUBJECT: a serene mountain landscape with river and pine trees] built entirely from small 3D voxels, Minecraft-diorama style at high fidelity, STRICT muted palette: slate-blue and dusty navy with white snow, coral-salmon accent patches, sage-green foliage, no bright greens, no browns, soft even studio light, isolated diorama on a clean white ground with generous empty space above for typography
entries.composition: isolated diorama occupying the lower half of a white page; headline sits in the clean white above; page background matches the white so the asset floats in the layout

manta.take: A little model landscape floating on a white page, using only blue, coral and green. Not the 3D blocks, the old-style lettering or the muted green button; redraw the mountains in Manta's own illustration style.

mmm-infra.take: An old-style headline with one phrase in a muted colour on an off-white page, and a scene filling the lower half of the first screen: the finished aqueduct could take that lower half. Not the 3D blocks, the meditation-app copy or the Sign In button, which is software chrome on a brochure site (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: Roamfield
entries.description: A travel-booking page with a floating white rounded menu bar (logo, links and a black "Book a trip" button) over a full-screen old-fashioned landscape picture of an autumn valley with a winding river, printed entirely in coarse coloured halftone (the tiny-dot texture of old newspaper photos). A large centred black headline in a plain modern font, "Made for travelers who'd rather drift than rush.", and grey text sit in the pale sky, followed by a black rounded "Find your stay" button. The colours are warm autumn orange, yellow and green below a pale blue-white dotted sky, with a paper grain over everything.
entries.note: The same trick as the Stillpage reference, stretched edge to edge: the whole scene is printed in halftone dots.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: pastoral landscape of [SUBJECT: autumn trees along a winding river], rendered as a vintage halftone print with coarse visible CMYK dots, warm oranges and greens against a cream paper sky, dot density fading toward the top for text space, nostalgic postcard composition
entries.composition: full-bleed halftone scene; the cream sky at center holds the serif headline; pill nav floats on top

manta.take: Take the pale sky holding the headline, with the whole scene below done in one consistent style; redrawn in Manta's own illustration style it becomes the opening screen of a guide. Not the headline font; the halftone is one to try (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3059); the wording is a lodging brand's, so no words are borrowed.

mmm-infra.take: A halftone-printed autumn valley under "Book a trip" is a leisure-travel mood, far from staff at development banks deciding whether to call an infrastructure advisor (brand sheet §1).

entries.title: Dualite
entries.description: A white page with a large black headline in old-style lettering (with little feet on the letters), "A masterpiece needs more than tools. It needs a master.", with "masterpiece" slanted, above a grey subheading, a blue rounded "Book a call" button and a white "How it works" button. The right half holds a large, grainy classical-style painting of a bearded man in blue and red robes reading a book, cut off by the right and bottom edges, over faint thin circles and lines in the background. A grey "Trusted by" line and five grey partner logos sit at the bottom left.
entries.note: An old master figure on a light, white page: the bearded scholar sells the product just by being shown reading.
vocabulary: white ground with thin orbit lines
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: grainy vintage color illustration of [SUBJECT: a bearded philosopher in blue robe and red drapery reading a book], engraved-poster texture, isolated on a clean white ground with faint thin orbit lines behind, warm classical palette, right-side placement leaving left half empty for text
entries.composition: right-half figure on white; faint orbit lines continue behind the left text column; logo row runs below

manta.take: Take a figure at full size on the right half with the text on the left on a white background: the same layout as the mascot's opening screen. Not the classical engraving-style figure, the slanted old-style lettering, or the circling lines.

mmm-infra.take: The arrangement with Mark in the scholar's place: a real photograph of him at full height on the right, his own words in an old-style headline on a white page on the left, and one blue "Book a call" button close to the logo blue (brand sheet §5). Not the classical painted figure or the orbit lines, and not the "Trusted by 100k+ users" logo row: no counts or client logos are held, and none may be invented.

entries.title: Begin Your Journey
entries.description: A login page split in two. The left half is white, with a folded-map icon, the heading "Begin Your Journey" in squared-off, techy lettering, labelled email and password boxes, a dark "INITIALIZE ACCESS" button, a "Continue with Google" button and small legal links. The right half is one full-height picture of a hooded figure seen from behind against a pale sky, drawn entirely in rows of small dark-grey typed characters on white (ASCII art).
entries.note: The whole right half is a single picture drawn in typed characters, so texture is the only decoration the page needs.
entries.source: cth9191/taste-vault, Chase's screenshot of an unrecorded site
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: [SUBJECT: a sailboat on calm water under a crescent moon] rendered entirely as grayscale ASCII art, thousands of monospace characters varying in density to form the image, black characters on white, crisp legible glyphs, full-bleed vertical panel composition
entries.composition: right panel of a hard vertical split - full-bleed ASCII art; white form panel left

manta.take: Widely spaced, techy capital letters on every control break brand sheet §4's rules on capitals and fonts, and the character art is the only decoration. The one piece worth keeping: the same split login layout the asterisk-login reference has.

mmm-infra.take: A sign-in page with "INITIALIZE ACCESS" in techy capitals and character art has no place on a brochure site with no accounts (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: CRIX - Dreamscape Product
entries.description: A full web page for a project and task-management tool, shown as two long columns of sections laid over a soft photo of misty pastel mountains and a flower field. The sections run through an opening screen with a dashboard picture, a statement paragraph, three numbered cards, feature cards, a dark "How the Platform Works" section, a white pricing section with three plan cards (the middle one tagged as recommended, with a black button), a testimonial on white, a dark closing section with a sign-up card, and a footer with huge faint "CRIX" letters over the landscape. Headlines are bold, plain modern lettering in black and grey, and the product is shown as light dashboard screenshots.
entries.note: Let one dreamlike landscape set the mood, then reuse it behind the product cards and the footer to tie the whole page together. It shows full page sections, pricing, a testimonial and a closing call to action, but its wording and endorsements are mock-up content, not real facts to reuse.
vocabulary: white fog fade into page content
rounded white cards with soft deep shadows
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: dreamlike cinematic landscape of [SUBJECT: layered mountain peaks above a sea of clouds], soft peach and pale pink sunrise with powder-blue shadows, delicate alpine flowers at the lower edges, one minimal pale stone rectangular portal on the horizon, airy atmospheric depth and soft natural light, matte photographic treatment, upper third fading into almost-white open sky for headline space, central lower area kept calm for a separately composited product screenshot, no text, no logos, no dashboard or interface elements
entries.composition: wide landscape behind a real HTML product screenshot centered in the lower half; headline sits upper-left in the pale sky with a separate CTA on the right; landscape and dashboard fade through white mist into the body. Reuse the landscape treatment in feature-card art and the footer; keep interface text, cards, and wordmark in code. This reference is a two-column presentation of a long page, not a two-column live-page layout.

manta.take: Switching between white and charcoal sections puts a dark night-style background on a section just because, exactly what brand sheet §2 forbids, and on a busy software product page. The one piece worth keeping: the landscape fading through white mist into the page content.

mmm-infra.take: A long software page of dashboards, pricing plans, alternating dark sections and a testimonial is the stacked, busy layout Mark rejected, on a site that sells nothing (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: SUMI
entries.description: A white page with a small spaced-out capitals line, a large black headline in a plain modern font, "Order from Chaos", a short grey subheading and a black rectangular "REQUEST BETA ACCESS" button. Below, a wide black-and-white ink-wash painting (brush and watered-down ink, as in Japanese sumi-e) of low hills and pine trees, with a starry mist rising between them, and one tiny human figure standing below it in the centre. Small menu words in capitals run across the top and a small status line and version number sit at the bottom of the otherwise empty white page.
entries.note: An ink-wash painting makes black and white look rich without any dotted texture, and fits a whole galaxy of stars inside the brushstrokes.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: sumi-e ink wash painting of [SUBJECT: mountain ridges with pine trees] dissolving into a starry galaxy cloud, black ink gradients with white star speckle, tiny lone human silhouette below, vast empty white paper above and around, meditative negative space, single accent nowhere - pure monochrome
entries.composition: centered illustration in the lower two-thirds of a white page; headline centered above; vast white margins all around

manta.take: Take the sparse brushed landscape with a lone figure and a speckle of stars: flipped to white marks on the dark blue-green night background, it is exactly what the footer brief asks for. Not the ink-wash painting style, the small computer-style status line, or the white page.

mmm-infra.take: One brushed ink scene in greys on a wide white page, with a single small figure for scale: the aqueduct could be drawn this way in the logo's grey, with Mark's words centred above it (brand sheet §4). Not the galaxy of stars, the spaced capitals, the "Request beta access" button or the status line, which are software chrome (§6).

entries.title: MacGeorge & Co.
entries.description: A dark, dimmed photo of a man fills the top screen, with three rounded translucent dark panels over it holding a serif name heading, a handwritten quote, a list of article headlines and a list of recent client requests. Below, a solid royal-blue band holds a centred serif heading, a short paragraph and a simple contact form with pill-shaped buttons in white and blue.
entries.note: Mark likes the videos on this site: the darkened film that plays behind the opening screen (seen here as a still) and the short "30+ years in 2 minutes" introduction. But he finds the site "much too busy". Kept for the video, not the layout.
vocabulary: serif display heading paired with sans body
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: Moody desaturated documentary portrait photograph, [SUBJECT: an older man in a business setting, face partly cropped and out of focus], heavily darkened with a charcoal overlay, soft low-contrast grey-brown tones, shallow depth of field, quiet and serious, with space left for text panels
entries.composition: The photo runs full-bleed behind the whole opening screen, dimmed so it acts as texture, and the person sits half-hidden behind the right-hand text panels rather than being framed as a portrait.

mmm-infra.take: The video: a quiet film behind the opening screen, and a short film of the man himself introducing his career. Not the layout: three stacked see-through panels, a subscribe-and-sign-in box and a live clock are what make it "much too busy" (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: Infralegal
entries.description: A full-width hero shows a cable-stayed bridge tower photographed from below, tinted entirely in burnt orange, with a fan of thin cables radiating across the frame. A light-weight white sans-serif headline and short tagline sit bottom-left, a small logo and plain text menu sit across the top, and a flat charcoal band starts below the hero.
entries.note: Mark named this as the site of another individual doing similar work: a one-person infrastructure law firm in Australia. He did not say what he likes about it. The likely interest is how a one-person practice presents itself with confidence ("Top tier advice, without the big firm baggage").
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: Full-bleed low-angle photograph looking straight up at [SUBJECT: a cable-stayed bridge pylon with radiating stay cables], graded as a monochrome burnt-orange duotone with deep brown shadows and soft glowing orange highlights, subtle out-of-focus lens flare bokeh, strong diagonal perspective lines, one side of the frame left calm for text
entries.composition: The photo fills the whole hero edge to edge, with its heavy structure on the right and the sparser cable lines on the left leaving room for the white headline.

mmm-infra.take: How a one-person practice presents itself: one confident line over one strong photograph of real infrastructure, with no claims to be a big firm (brand sheet §5). Not the saturated orange tint: Mark has not chosen any such colour (§2 is open).

entries.title: Richard Threlfall
entries.description: A slim white bar carries the name in bold spaced capitals, four plain capital links, and a live countdown (years, months, days, h:m:s) on the right. Below it a full-width video of Earth's curved horizon against black star-filled space fills the screen, with a blurred, nearly invisible two-line headline fading in over the dark sky.
entries.note: Mark likes the video on this site: a 30-second film of the Earth from space that opens the homepage (seen here as its opening still, because the screenshot browser could not play it). But its author is "more of a climate change advocate than a consultant", and Mark reads the site as "an advocacy platform as opposed to a marketing vehicle". Kept for the opening film, not the message.
entries.licence: No licence held — private reference only
entries.image_recipe: Photorealistic orbital view of [SUBJECT: Earth's curved horizon with a thin glowing blue atmosphere line, clouds and coastlines below], set against pure black space with sparse small white stars, high dynamic range, cinematic wide 16:10 crop, the planet filling the lower 40% and empty black sky above
entries.composition: The image spans the full width below a thin nav bar, with the planet's curve across the lower half and a large empty black sky above that holds a centred, blurred two-line headline.

mmm-infra.take: The opening film: one calm, full-screen moving picture before any text asks for anything. Not the advocacy: the campaign slogans and the countdown clock in the menu bar make it a campaign, not a marketing site (brand sheet §6).

entries.title: MMM Infra (current site)
entries.description: A plain white top bar holds a blue arched-bridge logo with small-caps serif wordmark on the left and a row of small grey sans-serif links on the right. Below it the opening screen splits in half: a photo of an older man in glasses and a pinstripe suit at a podium microphone, against a deep purple backdrop, sits on the left. On the right, on flat mid-grey, is a large white serif heading, an italic sans-serif tagline and a single white 'Get in Touch' button, and a darker grey band begins beneath.
entries.note: Mark's current site, built on Wix in 2019. He finds it "rather tired" and wants it refreshed: new images, possibly from his LinkedIn posts, and any structural improvements worth making. He wants it to feel like a personal, experienced advisor rather than a firm.
entries.licence: the client's own material, used for their project
entries.image_recipe: Documentary-style editorial portrait photograph, [SUBJECT: a senior professional speaking at a podium with a microphone, mid-conversation, wearing glasses and a dark pinstripe suit with a red tie], shot on a flat deep aubergine-purple backdrop, soft even frontal lighting, shallow depth of field, slightly desaturated natural skin tones, cropped from the chest up and filling the full height of the left half of the frame.
entries.composition: The portrait fills the full left half of the opening screen edge to edge, with the subject facing right toward the text panel, which holds the heading and button on a flat grey half.

mmm-infra.take: Keep the logo, which the opening animation builds, and a real photograph of Mark beside one clear "Get in Touch" button (brand sheet §4). Not the dated grey panels, and not the tagline "A Global Consulting Firm…", which speaks as a firm, not as Mark (§5).
